This stayed as just an inside joke for our group, until at the opening ceremony we had an idea: what if everyone at Bitcamp could have their own tamagotchi? glance.what: Platform linking medtech companies' device info to healthcare providers via chatbot.
glance.for_whom: Medical device companies and healthcare providers
glance.why: Gets device info to providers at the right time, aiding sales.

record.what_it_is: A platform where medical-product sales reps upload clinical and safety material and doctors use AI search and a chat copilot to preview relevant products before a visit, with AI-generated, trackable email campaigns to providers.
record.problem_and_user: Healthcare providers drowning in irrelevant vendor information, and sales reps who travel to hospitals without knowing whether a visit will be useful.
record.one_line_pitch: Platform where medical device reps upload product and clinical data and doctors use AI search to find relevant devices, replacing in-person sales visits.
record.target_user: healthcare providers and medical device sales reps
record.problem_statement: Doctors are swamped by irrelevant information while device sales reps spend time and money traveling to hospitals.
record.devpost_tagline: We’re revolutionizing how medical technology companies connect with healthcare providers: delivering the right information, to the right provider, at the right time.
devpost_first_sections: We were inspired by the challenge of improving HCP (Healthcare Provider) engagement. Doctors are often overwhelmed by irrelevant information, while sales reps spend time and money traveling to hospitals without knowing if their visit will add value. We wanted to create a solution that is smarter, more efficient, and more equitable: one that delivers the right information, to the right provider, at the right time.

Medicus is a digital platform that allows medical device sales reps to upload their products, complete with clinical research, safety data, and use cases. Using an AI search engine, doctors can easily preview relevant information before a sales visit. This helps doctors get the right information at the right time, while sales reps save resources and focus their visits on the hospitals that will truly benefit.

record.problem_and_user: Sim-racing hobbyists, here the builders themselves, wanting rig-mountable pedals recognized as an HID gamepad.
record.one_line_pitch: Custom machined racing-sim pedals with hall-effect sensors and load-cell brake feeding a Pico microcontroller.
record.problem_statement: Makers wanted self-built racing pedals that work as game input.
record.devpost_tagline: Creating custom metal fabricated pedals for a racing simulator setup — Including a clutch, brake, and accelerator pedal
devpost_first_sections: Hi! our names are Adrian Nelson and Aidan Chin, we are seniors at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. This HackUmass we sought out to make a our own Racing Simulation Pedal Set . Both of us are into cars and, love driving around. Our aim with these pedals was to make a custom set fabricated completely by us using materials found around the M5 ECE Makerspace!

The pedals each are individually connected to a microcontroller that takes in input from either a hall effect sensors (clutch and accelerator) or load cells (brake). What we aim to do is have physical input from our pedals translate into digital data for the car in a racing simulator to be able to drive normally.

record.problem_statement: Founders shipping AI-generated apps do not know if they are secure, and traditional scanners give jargon and false positives.

record.problem_and_user: People with Alzheimer's lose context for who they are talking to, causing social anxiety; the tool aims to restore confidence in conversations.
record.one_line_pitch: Wearable AI device that identifies people by face and voice embeddings and isolates the wearer's own speech to help recall conversations.
record.target_user: Wearers who want conversation recall, e.g. memory-impaired users
record.problem_statement: People struggle to remember who they met and what was said in conversations.
record.devpost_tagline: Wearable face/audio identity linker for people with Alzheimer’s

We built ReStory to act as a cognitive safety net - a wearable social second brain that restores a patient's dignity and agency by remembering faces and shared history so they don't have to.

glance.what: Pairs nearby moms via AI agents to trade outgrown baby clothes.

glance.what: Neural network and clustering analysis of basketball player roles and shooting.

TryOn allows users to virtually try on clothes using their own photo, without uploading any personal data to external servers. The application uses a body segmentation model to isolate the user’s silhouette and a powerful inpainting diffusion model to realistically overlay the selected clothing item. All processing happens locally on the user's device, ensuring full privacy.

record.what_it_is: An agentic finance ERP for month-end close at SaaS startups. Four worker agents only draft Proposals; a cross-vendor Red Team critiques them, an Advisor rules, and the CFO must confirm material items before the database lets anything post to the ledger.

record.problem_statement: Month-end close takes about ten days and CFOs will not let an unsupervised model post to the general ledger.
record.devpost_tagline: An agentic finance ERP where AI agents do the month-end close but requires approval before postage: a Red Team critiques, an Advisor rules, and the CFO confirms.
devpost_first_sections: At a growing startup, the month-end close still takes the finance team about ten days. Most of that time goes to matching deposits to invoices, chasing receipts and rebuilding revenue schedules in spreadsheets. Agents could already do most of this work. But ask a CFO whether they'd let a model post straight to the general ledger and the answer is no, because nobody can see what the agent did or stop it before it lands. We wanted agents that do the work and still can't change the books on their own.

Luyten is automated finance for 10x growth startups , built first for SaaS companies. Agents run the month-end close for a group of companies in two currencies, and every change passes through a gate: Worker agents propose. Bookkeeper, Revenue, Credit & Risk and Consolidation create Proposals. None of them can post. The Red Team critiques. It runs on models the workers don't use: Grok goes first, then Gemini adds what Grok missed. The Advisor rules. It approves, amends or rejects each Proposal and writes down why. record.what_it_is: An AI film-making studio where users talk to role-specific AI 'workers' (Director, Scriptwriter, Character Artist) in a 3D studio map, edit characters and scene frames by scribbling on images, and generate scene clips stitched into a final short film.
record.problem_and_user: Aspiring creators wanting an AI-generated short film without a traditional production pipeline.
record.one_line_pitch: Collaborative 3D studio where AI director, scriptwriter and character artist agents help users build and generate an AI movie.
record.problem_statement: Making a film with generative AI needs coordinated ideation, scripts, characters, scenes and video; the tool organises this as a regenerating node tree.
record.devpost_tagline: Make a film by talking to 3D workers in the studio
devpost_first_sections: Make an AI movie by talking to others in the 3D studio. First, chat with an Director to brainstorm ideas, build characters, and outline scenes. Secondly, collaborate with an Scriptwriter to flesh out dialogue, actions, and narrative details. Next, meet the Character Artist, where you can tweak style, clothes (ANYTHING YOU WANT) by simply scribbling on the character’s image for instant AI edits. Lastly, view a timeline of all the scenes and their frames, you could edit the scene images directly using scribbling tools and getting instant responses from our image gen AI. Finally ... generate the video ... VoiLa! Your very own AI movie is built!

Projects & Nodes – Each film is a project with a tree of nodes (logline, characters, objects, scenes, final film). Editing a parent marks descendants as stale so they regenerate with fresh context. Only required context is passed when generating each node. Generation Jobs – Every AI action (LLM plot, character sheet, image, video, final stitch) is a generation, queued as a job in Redis. Workers pick jobs, call providers (LLM, image, video), and store results and artifacts. Artifacts – JSON descriptors, images, frame stills, scene clips, and the stitched film are all stored as downloadable artifacts in blob storage.

record.devpost_tagline: Struggling with neural network basics? Meet Circuitry with Neural Networks. Visualize the classification process with LEDs as you watch neurons activate across layers to identify hand-drawn digits.
devpost_first_sections: We wanted to visualize a neural network with circuitry. Initially, we wanted to build a physical neural network (PNN) that conducts computations using conductance and resistance, with inspiration from https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.03372 . However, we pivoted to modeling a neural network using LEDs similar to The Stillwell Brain by Vsauce.

The CwNN classifies a drawn digit on the computer and lights up the corresponding activated neurons in the LED neural network. Layers are color-coded, and users can hover over activated neurons in specific layers to see which neurons in the previous layers caused it to activate. This enables users to visualize the process of a neural network better.

devpost_first_sections: There are an estimated 160 million deafblind people in the world, and many still lack access to real-time information in educational settings. A deafblind student's access to classroom content depends almost entirely on the availability of a human interpreter, who may not be present, may not keep up, and costs money most schools do not have. Existing braille displays are extremely expensive, costing $3,000–$15,000, and they cannot process a photo of handwritten notes or an audio recording of a teacher explaining a concept. Education promises equal access to knowledge, but for deafblind learners, it remains fundamentally inaccessible. We wanted to build a device that finally changes that.

We built an affordable braille machine where images or audio captured through a connected computer is automatically transcribed and transmitted to our custom braille display, which physically raises and lowers pins to spell out the content. record.one_line_pitch: Autonomous red-team versus blue-team simulation against a live vulnerable API, where Gemini writes patches that are verified by replaying the original exploit.
record.problem_statement: Security tools find vulnerabilities but rarely confirm that fixes work, and adaptive testing usually needs costly RL training.
record.devpost_tagline: We built an AI red team that attacks real servers, reasons like a hacker, needs no per-environment retraining, compresses its own inputs with entropy math, and verifies every patch it generates.
devpost_first_sections: Most security tools find vulnerabilities but never confirm the fix works. We wanted to build something that closes the full loop - attack, detect, patch, and verify, autonomously - with no human in the loop. We also wanted to challenge the assumption that adaptive AI security testing requires expensive RL training pipelines, drawing inspiration from self-evolving multi-agent (SEMA) (Ma 2026), a StarCraft II AI paper whose entropy pruning techniques translated surprisingly well to cybersecurity telemetry.

Arena runs a continuous adversarial simulation against a live vulnerable FastAPI server. An Ollama-powered red team reasons about what to attack next, a rule-based blue team detects and mitigates in real time, and Gemini generates vulnerability reports and code patches at episode boundaries. Every patch is verified by re-running the exact exploit that found the vulnerability. If the attack still works, the patch is rejected.

FinHealth acts like your personal financial assistant, all in one place: Stock Recommendations: Our dashboard highlights recommended stocks and shows related news with sentiment analysis (positive, neutral, or negative). Context-Aware AI Chatbot: This chatbot doesn’t just answer random questions—it tailors its responses to the stocks you’re tracking, recent market news, or your personal questions. Tailored Investment Plans: By entering your personal financial situation and investment goals, FinHealth creates a customized plan that aligns with your vision and risk tolerance. Portfolio Analysis: Even if you only have a screenshot of your portfolio, FinHealth can parse it to provide deeper insi

glance.what: Webcam-based rehab coach giving guided drills and posture scores.
glance.for_whom: Patients doing rehab exercises at home
glance.why: Gives patients feedback and reports to share with clinicians.

record.what_it_is: A browser-based home-rehab coach for stroke and injury recovery: the webcam tracks body keypoints during guided exercises, computes joint angles, range of motion and left/right symmetry, counts and grades reps, and has Gemini write a plain-English report (ElevenLabs for voice).
record.problem_and_user: People doing physiotherapy at home after stroke or injury who lack objective feedback, and clinicians who want measurable progress data.
record.one_line_pitch: Browser-based home rehab coach that uses a webcam and pose tracking to score symmetry and range of motion, then writes a Gemini report.
record.problem_statement: Post-stroke or injury rehab is hard to access and hard to measure objectively at home.
record.devpost_tagline: Rehabit turns your webcam into a rehab coach—guided drills, live symmetry/ROM & posture scores, and a Gemini-powered report you can share with your clinician.
devpost_first_sections: Rehab after stroke or injury is hard to access and even harder to measure at home. We wanted something anyone could run in a browser that gives objective feedback , not just “how did it feel?”

Rehabit turns a webcam into a home rehab coach. Users follow short guided drills— arms up , elbow flex/extend to shoulders , and sit-to-stand . We track joint angles and posture to compute: Symmetry Score (left vs right) Range of Motion (ROM) % Rep quality (speed, control, trunk lean) A Gemini call turns these numbers into a readable plain-English report and simple progress notes you can share. No wearables, no install.

glance.what: Banking app with regular features plus treasure-finding adventures.
glance.why: Makes banking fun via treasure-hunting adventures.

record.what_it_is: Treasure-hunt themed banking app for Desjardins: normal withdraw, deposit and invest actions plus camouflage that blends the display with camera colors, a compass for a second device, hands-free voice control, and ML detection of a second viewer to hide details.
record.problem_and_user: Page states none; framed around Desjardins' chameleon challenge, protecting users in risky or adventurous situations.
record.one_line_pitch: Banking app with deposit/withdraw/invest that camouflages its colors from the camera, doubles as a compass, supports voice, and hides details when a second face appears.
record.target_user: mobile banking users on the move
record.problem_statement: Desjardins Chameleon's Eye challenge: banking software that adapts to adventurous environments while staying secure.
record.devpost_tagline: A compact banking software that reliably performs all the regular tasks of a banking software while doubling as a tool to aid you find treasure on adventures.
devpost_first_sections: Our inspiration for this project was the Desjardins "Chameleon's Eye" challenge. When we saw this challenge presented, we instantly knew that it would be a difficult task, but that we would excel with it.

Essentially, our project performs all the regular tasks of a banking software, such as withdrawing, depositing and investing, all while performing other tasks that may aid in an adventure. For example, it automatically camouflages itself using any colours the device's camera picks up and acts as a compass for a second device. Additionally, we ensured that in any sticky situations the application can be used hands-free with voice controls. In order to preserve the security of all of our software's users, we used machine learning to detect a second person's presence and hide the user's details.

glance.what: Agentic AI turning textbook text into short, easy-to-understand videos.
glance.why: Makes dense textbook material easier to learn from video.

record.what_it_is: A six-agent CrewAI pipeline that turns a topic, PDF or image into a narrated Manim-animated explainer video. Claude writes scripts and animation code, LMNT supplies voice, and a quality-check agent sends videos back for fixes.
record.problem_and_user: Educators and students who learn advanced topics from dense textbooks and lack accessible visual explanations.
record.one_line_pitch: Six-agent CrewAI pipeline that turns a topic or document into a narrated Manim-animated educational video, using Claude for code and LMNT for voice.
record.problem_statement: Manim-style explanatory animations like 3Blue1Brown's need heavy programming skill that educators and students lack.
record.devpost_tagline: Many advanced topics are only taught through dense media such as textbooks. Using Agentic AI, our team created a platform that takes text, and transforms it into an easy-to-understand, simple video.
devpost_first_sections: Simply put, we were inspired by 3Blue1Brown. Grant Sanderson of 3Blue1Brown taught complex mathematical and scientific topics intuitively through targeted, minimalist animations. Our team comes from a wide array of technical backgrounds (including applied mathematics, computer science, data science, and data theory). While tools like Manim (The image generation tool that Sanderson uses in 3Blue1Brown) are powerful, they require significant programming expertise. Our goal was to build a system that allows educators and students to generate these high-quality, explanatory videos simply by providing a topic or a block of text, making advanced learning more accessible to everyone.

EduAgent is an automated video generation pipeline that transforms a user's text-based prompt into a short, animated educational video. A user can input a concept (e.g., "The Pythagorean Theorem," "How does a 4-stroke engine work?"), and the system will: Research and Script: Break down the topic into a logical, easy-to-understand video. Generate Visuals: Create corresponding Python code for the Manim animation library to visualize each part of the script. Synthesize Voice: Produce a natural-sounding voiceover that reads the script. glance.what: Turns any idea into a Lego-style building design with step-by-step instructions.
glance.why: Lets anyone build custom Lego designs without expertise.

record.what_it_is: A multi-agent system that turns a sentence into a buildable Lego model. A planner slices the design into layers, builders place bricks, a deterministic inspector checks physics and connectivity, and a vision critic reviews; the browser streams the build in 3D and exports a purchase link.
record.problem_and_user: Lego hobbyists whose finished builds gather dust and who want new designs from existing bricks.
record.one_line_pitch: Turns a sentence into a buildable 3D LEGO model using planner, builder, inspector and vision-critic agents with live streaming and steering.
record.problem_statement: LLMs generate poor 3D structures (floating bricks); users want to redesign builds from existing bricks.
record.devpost_tagline: Turn any idea into a Lego design.
devpost_first_sections: We love building Legos, but oftentimes our builds end up collecting dust on top of the shelf. What if we could use our existing pieces and switch up our own designs?

Bricked turns a sentence into a 3D lego model. You watch a team of AI agents plan, execute and validate the design. A planner slices it into layers, a builder fills it with different lego shapes, and an inspector physics check each step. The model stream it's building process live, with an option to jump in and steer the AI towards your vision. You can also use natural language to tweak and modify existing models.

glance.what: AI agent turning meeting decisions into enforceable specs, checking code against them.
glance.for_whom: Software teams using Jira and GitLab
glance.why: Keeps code aligned with decisions made in meetings.

record.what_it_is: Platform that extracts decisions from uploaded meeting notes with GPT models, proposes Jira ticket updates that a human approves before syncing, and checks GitLab pull requests via webhook against the agreed rules, explaining violations.
record.problem_and_user: PMs, tech leads and engineers whose meeting decisions drift from tickets and code.
record.one_line_pitch: AI that extracts decisions from meeting notes, syncs Jira tickets after human approval, and checks GitLab pull requests against those decisions.
record.problem_statement: Specs and meeting decisions drift from implementation; PMs manually reconcile Jira and developers unknowingly violate specs.
record.devpost_tagline: Codence is an AI agent that turns meeting decisions into enforceable specs by syncing Jira tickets and validating GitLab code against agreed rules.
devpost_first_sections: What inspired us Modern product development moves fast, but alignment often lags behind. Now, with AI tools writing code faster than ever, we’re seeing an ironic gap: speed has increased — but product quality hasn’t. Teams can generate code in seconds, but if that code doesn’t reflect the latest meeting decisions, it's just fast wrong work. We were inspired by this growing mismatch between decision-making and implementation . PMs spend hours manually checking Jira tickets. Developers unknowingly violate specs that were never updated. We asked: What if an AI could watch over these processes and enforce alignment? That’s how Codence was born — to make sure product consensus becomes code realit

glance.what: Stock and crypto learning app with market charts and P2P lending.
glance.why: Teaches market basics and lending through a simple interface.

record.what_it_is: An investor-protection web platform combining a CNN-LSTM model that predicts stock and REIT direction, sentiment analysis of news and Reddit, a Solidity peer-to-peer crypto-collateral loan marketplace, and an investing-mistakes quiz.
record.problem_and_user: New and first-time investors with limited capital facing misinformation, opaque risk and high perceived risk in stocks and crypto.
record.one_line_pitch: Investor-protection platform combining a CNN-LSTM stock/REIT direction predictor with sentiment analysis, a Solidity peer-to-peer crypto loan marketplace and an investing-mistakes quiz.
record.problem_statement: New investors face misinformation and risk and hesitate to start with limited capital.
record.devpost_tagline: Learn Quick, Make Bread | Market and Sentient Analysis, Peer to Peer Blockchain Lending and Dark Mode
devpost_first_sections: Our team was inspired by the increasing number of new investors joining the market each year and wanting to protect them from the vast amounts of misinformation and risk that is out there. We wanted to create a solution that not only helps them manage their investment risks but also empowers them to learn more about the ins and outs of investing.

Bread Bot offers 3 unique opportunities to reduce investment risk through these key components: machine learning models that give predictions for stocks/real estate investment trusts (REITSs) to move up or down, a Web3-based blockchain application allowing users to get and receive loans, and an interactive quiz to educate users on what NOT to do when investing.

glance.what: Parking payment app: pay smarter and park faster.
glance.why: Makes paying for parking quicker and simpler.

record.what_it_is: A usage-based parking web app: pick a spot on a TomTom map, start a live session, watch cost accrue, then settle the exact amount in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger testnet. Echo AI by Merit supplies pricing, explanations and login.
record.problem_and_user: Drivers who must prepay fixed parking blocks, overpay or risk tickets, and deal with meters and card fees.

record.problem_statement: Parking meters need coins or cards and are clunky; drivers want seamless real-time pay-per-use payments.
record.devpost_tagline: Pay Smarter, Park Faster
devpost_first_sections: The frustration of traditional parking systems—fumbling for cash, worrying about overstaying, and high credit card fees—inspired us to create ParkPay. We envisioned a seamless, blockchain-powered parking experience where payments happen automatically and transparently. By combining the XRP Ledger's fast micropayments with AI-powered insights, we set out to revolutionize how people park and pay.

ParkPay is a real-time, blockchain-based parking payment platform that eliminates the hassle of traditional parking meters. Users can: Start parking sessions with one click—no coins, no cards, no hassle Pay automatically using RLUSD (Ripple USD) on the XRP Ledger with per-second billing precision Get AI-powered pricing through Echo AI by Merit, which dynamically calculates fair rates based on location, time, and demand Track sessions in real-time with live billing updates and transparent cost breakdowns Connect their XRPL wallet to fund accounts and manage payments seamlessly The platform features Merit's Echo AI authentication for secure sign-in, and real-time WebSocket connections for live

glance.what: Voice-first healthcare concierge that triages, finds providers, and books care.
glance.for_whom: Patients seeking urgent or routine care
glance.why: Helps patients get the right care quickly with cost estimates.

record.what_it_is: A voice-first healthcare navigation concierge: a user speaks a health problem, and a set of Fetch.ai agents triage urgency, find real in-network providers, estimate out-of-pocket cost, take a test-mode deposit and book, then read the confirmation back by voice.
record.problem_and_user: Patients, elderly people, caregivers and non-native speakers who struggle to work out whom to see, cost, and booking.
record.one_line_pitch: Voice or text health concern triaged by an orchestrator of Fetch.ai agents that route emergencies to 911, find nearby providers, estimate out-of-pocket cost and guide booking.
record.problem_statement: Finding appropriate care, its cost and booking an appointment is fragmented across many steps for patients.
record.devpost_tagline: CareLoop is a voice-first healthcare concierge that triages urgency, finds nearby providers, estimates cost, and helps book care from one calm conversation.
devpost_first_sections: CareLoop was inspired by how stressful healthcare navigation can be. Even when someone knows they need care, they still have to figure out urgency, insurance, cost, providers, and booking, often while anxious or helping a loved one.

CareLoop lets users describe a health concern by voice or text. It triages urgency, routes emergencies to 911, finds nearby providers, estimates out-of-pocket cost, and helps guide appointment booking in one conversation.

glance.what: Camera and 3D twin tracking warehouse inventory in real time, forecasting demand.
glance.why: Lets teams see stock live and act faster on demand.

record.what_it_is: A 3D warehouse operations dashboard that shows racks and shelves from a generated template warehouse and a Neon Postgres-backed main warehouse, with OCR of shelf images appearing only as pending observations until a human edits stock.
record.problem_and_user: Small warehouse teams who need to know what is on each shelf and its condition, where manual counts are slow and single photos miss hidden boxes.
record.one_line_pitch: 3D warehouse dashboard linking inventory records in Neon Postgres with OCR of shelf photos, shown as pending observations until a human edits stock.
record.problem_statement: Small warehouse teams count stock by hand and photos alone miss hidden boxes or sealed contents.
record.devpost_tagline: SI-Storage uses cameras, AI, and a 3D digital twin to track inventory across warehouses in real time, forecast demand, and help teams act faster.
devpost_first_sections: Small warehouse teams need to know what is on a shelf, where it is, and whether it is usable. Manual counts are slow, while a single photograph misses hidden boxes and cannot verify the contents of sealed cartons. We wanted one workspace that connects camera evidence, inventory records, and a spatial view without treating a label as proof of stock.

SI Storage brings multiple warehouses into a 3D operations dashboard. The shared Main Warehouse reads actual inventory balances and events from Neon PostgreSQL. Users can inspect racks and shelves, view inventory alerts and history, and manually correct a shelf's product, quantity, and condition. Selecting a zone loads its assigned pair of stored Cloudinary warehouse images, extracts readable labels, and displays the resulting items as pending observations. The planned full version will use calibrated camera captures, cross-view matching, human review, demand forecasts, and warehouse-specific accounts.

glance.what: Hands-free cooking with Snapchat Spectacles showing recipes and voice control.
glance.why: Keeps cooking clean and easy with voice-guided steps.

record.what_it_is: A Snapchat Spectacles Lens that turns a cooking video into timestamped recipe steps and shows the video, directions and a timer in AR, locked to the cook's head movement, controllable by voice or AR buttons.
record.problem_and_user: Home cooks, especially beginners, who have messy hands and don't want to handle a phone or recipe book while cooking.
record.one_line_pitch: Snapchat Spectacles AR cooking assistant that overlays a recipe video, timestamped steps and a timer that follow the cook's head movements.
record.problem_statement: Cooks with messy hands cannot easily touch a phone or flip through a recipe while following a video.
record.devpost_tagline: See your recipe. Hear your next step. Control it all with your voice. Our project makes cooking easy, clean, and hands-free with Snapchat Spectacles.
devpost_first_sections: Imagine cooking your favorite dish, hands covered in flour, without ever needing to touch your phone or flip through a recipe book. Our project turns Snapchat Spectacles into your personal kitchen assistant — overlaying step-by-step recipe videos right onto your real-world cooking space, with voice commands to pause, play, or skip ahead. It's hands-free, hassle-free cooking made simple, perfect for beginners and busy home chefs alike.

Ghostface Cookah provides an interactive video player, recipe directions with timestamps based off the video transcript, and a manual timer that can all follow the user's head movements. Our video player allows the user to play, pause, and skip ahead to the next or previous step cooking step. These can all be controlled through augmented buttons or voice commands.

glance.what: Credit and spending app offering smart alerts and stress-easing lending.
glance.why: Supports sustainable borrowing and reduces financial stress.

record.what_it_is: Wings pairs an iMessage financial coach with a WingsPay BNPL demo web app. Knot and Nessie transaction data in Snowflake feed a credit-scoring model and LLM answers, so users get dynamic credit offers or spending advice.
record.problem_and_user: People with thin credit files, such as new immigrants and young earners, plus lenders wanting behavior-based credit decisions.
record.one_line_pitch: Dynamic credit-scoring system that combines bank-statement and spending data into a score and loan recommendation, delivered through an iMessage chatbot.
record.target_user: new immigrants and young earners with thin credit files
record.problem_statement: Traditional credit systems exclude people with short credit histories such as new immigrants and young earners.
record.devpost_tagline: Finance is a dynamic equilibrium. Our credit and spending advisory layer supports sustainable borrowing and proactive guidance - so you feel supported, not stretched or stressed.
devpost_first_sections: Traditional credit systems exclude people without long credit histories especially new immigrants and young earners. We wanted to rethink credit as something dynamic, based on both real financial behavior and bank statements. Our goal: support people when they deserve more credits, and guide them when they’re stretched, creating healthier financial health instead of stress.

Our platform provides real-time lending and spending guidance based on the user’s current financial capacity, not just their past credit history. We securely aggregate financial data (bank transactions, income patterns, cash flow signals, detailed spending breakdowns), a wide data modality that most traditional bureau and institutions don’t capture. A dynamic credit model evaluates the user’s financial health and credit worthiness in real time. When the user is in a healthy financial state, the app extends credit that they can confidently afford. glance.what: Two-player co-op puzzle game where one player is trapped inside a cube.
glance.why: Makes teamwork and communication fun through puzzles.

record.what_it_is: A browser two-player pixel-art co-op puzzle game: one player walks the outside of a cube and the other is trapped inside its mirrored dark walls; they talk via proximity voice to solve puzzles on six faces. Solo play uses a Gemini/ElevenLabs AI partner.
record.problem_and_user: Friends playing co-op games who want communication to be the core mechanic; solo players get an AI partner.
record.one_line_pitch: Two-player co-op puzzle game on a shared cube: one player outside, one trapped inside in a mirrored dark world, talking to solve six faces.
record.problem_statement: Wanted a co-op game where communication between friends is the whole point; solo players get an AI partner.
record.devpost_tagline: Cubic is a two-player co-op game where one player walks the outside of a cube and the other is trapped inside, and you solve puzzles together by talking each other through the walls.
devpost_first_sections: We play a lot of "friendslop" co-op games together and wanted to make our own, one where communication (or miscommunication) between two friends is the whole point.

Two players share one cube. One walks the outside, the other is trapped inside, where everything is dark and mirrored. You can't see each other's screens, so you talk through the walls: read codes, count objects, guide each other across invisible paths and pass items to solve all six faces. Solo players get an AI partner.

glance.what: AI assistant generating Verilog and physical chip layouts from text prompts.
glance.why: Speeds chip design from idea to fabrication.

record.what_it_is: A web tool that turns a natural-language description or hand-drawn sketch of a circuit into Verilog, synthesizes it with Yosys, renders an interactive DigitalJS schematic, and pushes the design toward a fab-ready GDS file via OpenLane, with a chat assistant for questions.
record.problem_and_user: Students learning logic design and engineers who spend long hours writing Verilog and iterating layouts.
record.one_line_pitch: Natural-language or sketch-to-chip tool: Gemini and a Letta agent write Verilog, then Yosys, OpenLane and DigitalJS produce schematics and a fab-ready GDS file.
record.problem_statement: Hardware design is slow and hard to learn; students and engineers struggle with Verilog and abstract diagrams.
record.devpost_tagline: Chips and circuits, from ideation to fabrication in a matter of seconds
devpost_first_sections: Designing hardware is hard. Engineers spend countless hours writing Verilog and refining circuit layouts, while students face a steep learning curve with abstract logic gate diagrams. As undergraduates, we've struggled to actively engage with circuits and learn through hands-on experimentation. We've also seen PhD students spend years iterating on chip designs through long cycles of development and testing. That’s why we built ChipChat - a natural language interface that lets users describe a circuit and instantly gain access to an end-to-end chip development pipeline.
